items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then he got Adams – Joe Adams... he told Joe to have me come to California. He wanted to record me.

ctx.x: This was like 1958, 1959-ish, end of the ’50s.
Yeah. You see, we all traveled. They were travelling too. We’d meet up in different towns, and I got to know Ray. Then he got Adams – Joe Adams . . .
